description: Get the official rules definition for a Magic keyword ability (e.g., "Flying", "Deathtouch", "Equip"). Use this when a user asks how a keyword works or what its rules text says. Different from get_glossary — this is specifically for keyword abilities with rules text.

name.description: Keyword name to look up (case-insensitive). Examples: "Flying", "Equip", "Scry".

name: get_keyword
